name: Panic at the Pantry
subtitle: A five-course cartoon showdown
promotional_text: Five courses. One brave little egg. Jump, dash, parry, and shoot through an original cartoon kitchen adventure. Play offline with no ads or in-app purchases.
description:
Breakfast fights back.

Meet Sunny: a little egg with a chef’s beret, a finger gun, and a very big kitchen problem. Take on five larger-than-life bosses in an original cartoon action adventure for Mac.

A FIVE-COURSE FOOD FIGHT
Face Baron von Toast, Duke de Blend, Madame Whistle, and Sir Sizzle. Earn Spicy victories against all four to unlock the final showdown with Chef Pepperpot. Every boss has distinct attacks and a faster second phase.

SMALL HERO, BIG MOVES
Double-jump over danger, dash through trouble, parry pink food, and charge a powerful energy ball. Learn which attacks can be destroyed and which shielded attacks you must dodge.

CHOOSE YOUR HEAT
Play the first four bosses on Cozy, Regular, or Spicy. The final Chef encounter is always Spicy. Your unlock progress and best results are saved on your Mac.

MADE FOR YOUR MAC
Enjoy original vector artwork, a swing soundtrack, keyboard controls you can customize, and fullscreen or windowed play.

Play offline. No game account, advertising, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. The game interface is currently in English.
review_notes: Native offline single-player Mac game. No sign-in, network access, ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. The interface is English. Keyboard controls can be changed in Options > Keyboard. Default keys: arrows move; Space/Z double-jump; hold F to shoot; D dash; G parry pink food; Q energy ball when the five-card meter is full; Esc pause; H/F1 help; B boss selection. Fullscreen is the default; F11 toggles windowed mode. Bosses 1–4 are immediately playable. Defeat all four on Spicy to unlock Chef Pepperpot; Cozy/Regular victories do not count. Chef Pepperpot always uses Spicy difficulty. Progress and preferences are saved locally. The app uses only its App Sandbox container and does not need network, microphone, camera, or user-selected file entitlements.
privacy_declaration: No data collected by the game. Local preferences, progress, and best results stay on the player’s Mac.
calculated_age_rating: 13+ globally, with regional variations assigned by Apple
availability: Public, free in all 175 selected countries and regions after approval
